newsitem.title: UK: Rain continues in eastern England crop areas.
newsitem.headline: Rain continues in eastern England crop areas.

text.p: It was still raining in much of eastern England by 1320 GMT on Friday, with measuring stations in East Anglia reporting between four and eight millimetres of rain between 0600 GMT and midday GMT, a spokesman for the London weather centre said.
Farmers in the area are desperate for sustained rainfall, to up soil moisture and replenish reservoirs after a prolonged dry spell
"It's not finished yet," he said. "There's more rain on its way for tomorrow."
The weather is likely to remain unettled over the weekend and into early next week, a spokesman for the meteorological office said.
"Wednesday looks like being the first clear day," he said.
